crossRefs.note: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of…
But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

translations.web: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
translations.bsb: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
translations.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
translations.asv: And the sea was rising by reason of a great wind that blew.
